name: verify-mute-persistence
description: Verifies the per-user mute preference: the toggle works on the LOBBY strip (regression - LobbyScreen renders its own TitleStrip and was not wired to App state), survives navigation to Draft/BP/Roster, and survives a full reload (relaunch) because it is stored in Redis on the user hash. Also confirms the unmuted state persists so the flag is not write-only. Never clicks .bnav-play - that leaves the lobby into a match.

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), classes: b?.className }); })()
steps.name: 0 - initial mute state on lobby

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); if (b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true') { b.click(); return 'was muted - clicked to unmute for baseline'; } return 'already unmuted'; })()
steps.name: 1 - normalise baseline to UNMUTED

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'false', expected: 'false' }); })()
steps.name: 2 - baseline is UNMUTED

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, hasActiveClass: b.className.includes('active'), label: b.getAttribute('aria-label'), PASS: p === 'true' && b.className.includes('active'), expected: 'CORE: clicking mute on the LOBBY must register' }); })()
steps.name: 3 - MUTE CLICK WORKS ON LOBBY

steps.expression: JSON.stringify(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('audio')).map(a => ({ src: (a.currentSrc || a.src || '').split('/').pop(), muted: a.muted, volume: Number(a.volume.toFixed(3)), paused: a.paused })))
steps.name: 4 - audio elements after mute

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); const onLobby = !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=lobby-screen]'); return JSON.stringify({ leftLobby: !onLobby, ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'true', expected: 'CORE: still muted after navigating to DRAFT' }); })()
steps.name: 5 - stays muted on DRAFT

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'true', expected: 'CORE: mute SURVIVES a full relaunch (loaded from Redis)' }); })()
steps.name: 6 - mute SURVIVES RELAUNCH

steps.expression: JSON.stringify(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('audio')).map(a => ({ src: (a.currentSrc || a.src || '').split('/').pop(), muted: a.muted, volume: Number(a.volume.toFixed(3)), paused: a.paused })))
steps.name: 7 - no audio playing after muted relaunch

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ onBattlePass: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=battle-pass-screen]'), ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'true', expected: 'CORE: still muted on BP' }); })()
steps.name: 8 - stays muted on BP

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'true', expected: 'CORE: still muted on ROSTER' }); })()
steps.name: 9 - stays muted on ROSTER

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'false', expected: 'unmute click registers' }); })()
steps.name: 10 - unmute click registers

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const p = b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ ariaPressed: p, PASS: p === 'false', expected: 'CORE: UNMUTED state also persists (flag is not write-only)' }); })()
steps.name: 11 - UNMUTE SURVIVES RELAUNCH
